stage: built and rendered at 1440 and 390 px; 68 controls hover-tested for tooltips (0 missing); no horizontal scroll at either width

choice-justified:adjacency-matrix.why: Router primary, built as a traceability table: layers by rows, agent-model sections and worked-out items as columns. Rows hold 3-6 items each, so a dense matrix grid would be mostly empty; the table keeps each cell's items legible.

title-states-what-this-is-and-for-whom.why: Headline states the finding; lede says what each column is.

whole-design-visible-on-one-screen-at-th.why: At 1440 the table is about 1.5 screens tall; eight layers with their items do not fit one screen without clipping text. Summary counts and per-row bars sit above the fold.

cold-reader-gets-the-mechanism-in-sixty-.why: Headline plus summary counts plus per-row bars carry the point.

form-matches-job-lists-scan-tables-compa.why: Job is compare layers against two sources; a table compares.

relationships-drawn-not-implied-by-adjac.why: Each item's relation to the agent model is drawn as a status mark with words, not implied by placement.

same-object-same-mark-across-every-view.why: One mark per status, used in summary, chips, bars and legend.

every-object-reveals-more-on-click-nothi.why: Every chip opens a detail panel with the note and a pinned GitHub link; sections show their text on hover.

one-primary-drawing-with-callouts-not-pa.why: The middle column is text: agent-model section summaries have no visual form beyond the row they sit in.

attributed-claims-traced-to-source-no-in.why: Every worked-out item links to its file at a pinned revision; decisions 010 and 012 wording checked against source.

drawing-laid-out-by-engine-with-content-.why: Table layout by the browser; no node-link drawing.

structural-devices-encode-information-no.why: Bars encode status mix per layer; borders encode status.

no-generated-defaults-cream-serif-card-k.why: Removed all-caps headers and middle-dot separators; system sans; no card kit.

each-concept-drawn-in-a-shape-that-mirro.why: Used = filled, partly = half, not used = dashed outline (absent), conflict = orange square with warning.

white-space-separates-groups-and-carries.why: Rows separated by rules and padding.

structure-earned-by-content-not-imposed-.why: The eight layers are epistemic-warrant's own factorization, not invented here.

page-carries-its-date-and-version.why: Status line names both revisions and the date.

each-element-encodes-its-answer-visually.why: Status carried by mark, colour and border; text names it too for colourblind reading.

each-drawing-shows-relations-a-list-cann.why: Matrix relates layer, model section and worked item.

diagram-text-is-dom-or-svg-and-no-label-.why: All DOM text; screenshots show no overlaps.

context-quiet-subject-loud.why: Not-used items are quiet dashed outlines but counted loudly in the summary; conflicts are loud orange.

comparisons-use-identical-small-frames.why: Each layer row uses the same three-column frame.

one-highlighted-state-not-several.why: One chip selected and one filter active at a time.

object-count-within-density-budget-or-ag.why: 31 items in 8 rows, aggregated in summary and bars.

no-ellipsis-or-clipped-text-in-rendered-.why: No ellipsis in CSS; chips wrap; detail panel can overlap rows while open and closes with the x.

phone-and-laptop-each-have-a-layout-that.why: Rows become cards below 700px; checked at 390 with no horizontal scroll.

sources-listed-beside-views-and-picking-.why: Sources in status line; each chip links its source.

picking-an-item-lights-its-counterparts-.why: Clicking a status count highlights every item with that status; clicking again clears.

checks-measure-painted-geometry-after-fo.why: Playwright measured scrollWidth at 1440 and 390 after load.

groups-the-page-filters-by-have-one-view.why: Status groups related in the summary row.

non-specialist-front-door-is-a-question-.why: Ends with the one question asked of the reader.

reader-can-point-to-where-any-one-fact-l.why: Each item has its file link at a pinned revision.
